page.notes: The running head "SCRIPVVRÆ" is read as SCRIPTVRÆ, since the T looks like a V in the print. The Roman numeral in "Mosis I.I.II." is doubtful. "area" in the Apocalypse 9:20 entry is doubtful, and it may be "ærea". The chapter numbers in the left margin are read as Apocalypse and John chapter references. The "Michael" and "Mancipia" initials are decorated capitals.
